results.snippet: Simpson Strong-Tie is the operating subsidiary of Simpson Manufacturing and makes structural connectors, anchors, and fasteners for wood, concrete, and masonry construction. Its range is broad: reinforcement products include anchors, angles, bases, caps, connectors, fasteners, and hangers, and it also offers prefabricated shearwalls, powder-actuated tools, and adhesives.
